purpose: Minimize time-to-valid-alpha while preventing waste. Spend only when a measured research bottleneck cannot be solved adequately with already-owned/free resources.

existing_paid_stack.rule: Treat existing subscriptions as sunk baseline for routing decisions. Do not add overlapping AI subscriptions unless a measured capacity bottleneck persists after routing optimization.
existing_paid_stack.chatgpt_budget_rule: Keep total ChatGPT subscription plus usage-credit spend <= USD 250 per month. Use included allowance first; no automatic credit reload or plan upgrade.
existing_paid_stack.chatgpt_high_power_routing: Prefer GPT-6 Astra High in Work/Codex for hard execution and GPT-6 Pro/Astra for high-value scientific adjudication, while using deterministic compute for mechanical work.

optimization_target: scientifically defensible 2x/90-day lift over base rate

priority_order.name: owned_and_free_data_first
examples: Kraken historical trades/OHLCVT and public market endpoints
priority_order.rule: Do not buy a dataset when an owned/free source can answer the same predeclared hypothesis with adequate chronology, fidelity and coverage.

priority_order.name: targeted_historical_data_gap
examples: pay-as-you-go historical data for an exact blocked contract
trusted point-in-time membership/history required by a predeclared test
priority_order.unlock_condition: A named candidate or 2x study is BLOCKED_DATA_CONTRACT and the exact missing fields/venues/time span are frozen before purchase.
priority_order.kill_condition: Do not renew if the acquired data does not materially change information gain, candidate viability, or validation capability.

priority_order.name: derivatives_and_positioning_data
priority_order.unlock_condition: At least one predeclared hypothesis explicitly requires derivatives features unavailable with adequate history/fidelity from free sources.
renew_only_if: produces measurable out-of-sample feature lift or useful falsification
unblocks at least one frozen research contract

priority_order.name: burst_compute
priority_order.unlock_condition: A valid research queue is waiting primarily on compute rather than code, data, review or scientific design.
rules: Prefer CPU/RAM for vectorized backtests unless profiling proves GPU benefit.
Use ephemeral/burst compute; no idle 24/7 premium instances.

priority_order.name: incremental_storage
priority_order.unlock_condition: Certified historical datasets exceed current local/Supabase capacity or egress-safe workflow requires dedicated object storage.
priority_order.rule: Store normalized immutable Parquet partitions and deduplicate aggressively before buying more capacity.

priority_order.name: premium_microstructure_data
priority_order.unlock_condition: A newly frozen candidate has already passed cheap train/validation after realistic costs AND its mechanism specifically depends on microstructure fields unavailable from lower-cost sources.
additional_requirements: exact fields, exchanges, date ranges and expected decision impact documented before purchase
user approval before any recurring charge
cancel/downgrade after the bounded validation experiment unless measurable value is demonstrated

priority_order.name: more_ai_subscriptions_or_agents
priority_order.unlock_condition: Only after evidence shows model capacity is the binding bottleneck after deterministic routing, existing ChatGPT/Claude capacity and the API budget are fully utilized efficiently.
priority_order.rule: Do not add AI subscriptions merely to increase worker count.

LEVEL_1.use_when: One exact data or compute bottleneck is blocking high-information work.

LEVEL_2.use_when: Multiple validated workloads are bottlenecked and lower-cost resources are demonstrably insufficient.

LEVEL_3.use_when: A candidate has passed cheap validation and expensive data/compute is required for deep validation.

actions: list every recurring and usage-based research cost
downgrade/cancel resources that failed renewal criteria
reallocate freed budget to the highest-priority proven bottleneck
verify total ChatGPT subscription + credit spend remains <= USD 250
verify Work Astra High, Codex Astra High and GPT-6 Pro/Astra are being used on distinct high-value tasks rather than duplicated low-value work
monthly_review.rule: Never preserve a subscription solely because it may become useful later. Hard constraint: do not exceed USD 250/month in total ChatGPT-related spend without a new explicit owner decision.

lead_must_report: proactively flag the user when a deeply reviewed spend opportunity crosses the VERY_HIGH/EXTREME benefit threshold
reporting.language: Use evidence-gated wording. Do not claim a purchase will make the system profitable.

proactive_spend_flagging.lead_duty: Continuously look for high-ROI opportunities where additional spending would materially accelerate or strengthen the master objective. Do not wait for the user to ask.
proactive_spend_flagging.trigger: Flag the user when evidence indicates a purchase is VERY_HIGH or EXTREME expected benefit relative to cost, or when a paid resource is the binding bottleneck to a high-value experiment/validation step.
review_scope: independent backtest/execution engines and realistic execution/simulation infrastructure
AI/API capacity only if proven binding
recommendation_must_include: one-time versus recurring cost and estimated monthly total
what experiment or validation becomes possible
cheaper viable alternative if one exists
proactive_spend_flagging.notification_threshold: Do not bother the user for marginal convenience. Notify proactively for purchases judged likely to create a material improvement in research speed, evidence quality, validation realism, or probability of discovering genuine alpha/2x lift.
proactive_spend_flagging.authority: Recommendation only. Never purchase, subscribe, upgrade, or incur a new charge without explicit user approval.
